target_customer: Finance teams at B2B companies, mostly SaaS and services businesses, that chase invoices and reconcile payments
problem: Invoice tracking and collections sit in spreadsheets and email, so cash arrives late and unpredictably.
business_model: B2B SaaS for accounts receivable with payments and cash application modules
product_category: Accounts receivable and cash collection software

founders.name: Alexandre Louisy
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as an engineer and CEO and co-founder.

founders.name: Barnaby Malet
founders.background_notes: Private Equity Wire (2021-06-15) calls him 'Upflow co-founder and CTPO'. Background not confirmed from a primary source.

competitors.name: Tesorio
competitors.what: AI cash flow and collections platform for finance teams

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with accounting systems and bank payments, plus reconciliation, are standard fintech engineering with regulatory touchpoints.

defensibility.rationale: Once connected to a company's ERP, invoices and customer payments, the tool is embedded in finance workflows, but several rivals sold similar software.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed the wedge according to sources; Upflow kept raising and now lists 500+ customers on its YC description.

market_need_then: TechCrunch 2019 described invoice tracking in Excel as the incumbent for small companies and startups trying to replace it. No spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Now upflow.io; earlier domains not found.

identity.visual_style: Modern B2B fintech; the site has a Brand page and an Inside Upflow blog
identity.voice_and_tone: Professional, collaborative; positions as financial relationship management

branding.brand_signature: Inside Upflow behind the scenes team blog
branding.community_and_virality: Company runs a public Inside Upflow blog series; no merch or meme evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: A short evocative name about cash flow and a clear category message; it competes with a similarly named company (Upflowy) but no source shows damage.

outcome_analysis: Upflow raised a seed in 2019 before YC, a $15M Series A in 2021 and a $5M extension in 2024, with total funding reported near $22.9M. It now claims 500 customers across 30 countries and 50 staff. Growth is steady in a crowded accounts receivable field, and a layoff tracker listing was seen but not confirmed.
notes: The 2021 Series A is reported by Silicon Canals, Crowdfund Insider, Finextra and The Paypers (search results; Finextra page returned 403). The 2024 extension is from Nordic9 and StartupIntros snippets with Lorimer Ventures leading. CB Insights lists 5 rounds including seeds in 2019 and 2020, total about $22.85M; the 2020 seed is not recorded as no second source found. Dealroom names Barnaby Malet and FundedIQ names Thibaud Elziere as co-founders but only aggregators say so, so they are not listed. A layoffs.fyi entry was found in search results for Upflow but not opened, so no layoff is claimed. Founder education and prior employers not found in opened sources. Competitors beyond Tesorio (G2 comparison pages are dated 2026) were not included. Barnaby Malet added as co-founder per Private Equity Wire (2021-06-15): https://privateequitywire.com/upflow-raises-usd15m-series-round/ . Thibaud Elziere is still not listed.
